changes.zh: 乾實驗封存核對（密碼子最佳化與數學模型 Block 1–3）：39 筆事實更新，10 筆改為 confirmed，2 筆改為 conflict，其餘補上來源與查核註記。
changes.en: Dry lab archive check over the codon optimisation and Math Model Blocks 1-3 facts: 39 facts updated, 10 moved to confirmed, 2 moved to conflict, the rest annotated with sources and what was checked.

changes.zh: confirmed 的判準：數值本身出現在專案封存的原始檔，或由已確認的輸入與物理常數精確重算得出；僅算術吻合但輸入仍未見原始檔者維持 pending 並註明。
changes.en: Rule used for confirmed: the value itself appears in a source file in the project archive, or it recomputes exactly from inputs and physical constants that are themselves confirmed. Where only the arithmetic checks and the input measurement has no archived raw file, the fact stays pending and says so.

changes.zh: WM-177 改為 conflict：野生型成熟 BoPep4 CDS 是八個連續腺嘌呤，不是頁面寫的七個。
changes.en: WM-177 moved to conflict: the wild-type mature BoPep4 CDS carries eight consecutive adenines, not the seven the page states.

changes.zh: WM-025 改為 conflict：K_M 與 k_cat 已確認，但次單元質量（36.5 / 37.6 / 41 kDa）與寡聚體（四聚體 / 三聚體）三處說法不一。
changes.en: WM-025 moved to conflict: K_M and k_cat are confirmed, but the subunit mass (36.5, 37.6 or 41 kDa) and the oligomer (tetramer or trimer) disagree across three sources.

changes.zh: WM-027 的歸屬衝突解決：常數屬於 Castillo-Hair et al. 2019，錯的是 releaf-wiki/build/model_figures.py:63 的註解。
changes.en: WM-027's attribution conflict is resolved: the constants are Castillo-Hair et al. 2019 and the error is the comment at releaf-wiki/build/model_figures.py:63.

changes.zh: WM-159（純化標籤，critical）：封存證明六月與七月所訂構築的 6xHis 在 C 端，待問範圍縮小為 8/16 之後實際訂了哪一種。
changes.en: WM-159, the purification tag and a critical fact: the archive proves the June and July orders carry 6xHis at the C terminus, narrowing the ask to which construct was ordered after 16 August.

changes.zh: 數學模型 Block 1 的所有數字（32%、32,767、19.8 kg/ha、399 county-season、365/419、7.9%/8.8%、索引查表與 NT$ 金額）在兩個專案資料夾中都找不到來源，維持 pending 並寫明已搜尋。
changes.en: Every Block 1 number (32%, 32,767, 19.8 kg/ha, 399 county-seasons, 365/419, 7.9%/8.8%, the index lookup tables and the NT$ figures) has no source in either project folder; the facts stay pending and now record that the search was done.

changes.zh: 完整紀錄與里程碑整理：records/2026-10-14-drylab-consolidation.md。
changes.en: Full write-up and milestone ledger: records/2026-10-14-drylab-consolidation.md.

changes.zh: 第二輪（對接、MD、胜肽設計稽核）：36 筆事實更新，20 筆改為 confirmed，2 筆改為 conflict。
changes.en: Second pass over the docking, MD and peptide-design audit facts: 36 facts updated, 20 moved to confirmed, 2 moved to conflict.

changes.zh: WM-159（純化標籤，critical）敲定為 confirmed：8/23 零件清單把 6xHis 列為 N 端並註明「never fuse His to Asn23」，六個 cassette 長度全部對上。Molecular Dynamics 頁說「移到 C 端」那一句，以及 GRAFT Methodology 的 C 端 6xHis（只適用六七月設計），需要改。
changes.en: WM-159, the purification tag and a critical fact, is settled as confirmed: the 23 August parts list puts the 6xHis at the N terminus with the note 'never fuse His to Asn23', and all six cassette lengths reproduce. The Molecular Dynamics sentence about moving the tag to the C terminus, and GRAFT Methodology's C-terminal 6xHis which applies only to the June and July designs, both need editing.

changes.zh: WM-105 敲定：實際跑的是 HADDOCK 2.5（haddock2.5-2026-07，121 次 production run，本機，Python 3.12）；頁面的 2.4 是協定論文的版本。value 改為 2.5。
changes.en: WM-105 settled: what ran is HADDOCK 2.5 (haddock2.5-2026-07, 121 production runs, local, Python 3.12); the 2.4 on the page is the protocol paper's version. The value is now 2.5.

changes.zh: WM-138 改為 conflict：Lys7–Asp129 的 98.7% / 2.81 Å 屬於 7-23 軌跡，野生型在同一受體殘基上只有 44.2%，頁面的歸屬相反。
changes.en: WM-138 moved to conflict: the 98.7% at 2.81 A for Lys7-Asp129 belongs to the 7-23 trajectory, while wild type sits at 44.2% on the same receptor residue, so the page has the attribution backwards.

changes.zh: WM-162 改為 conflict：「111 / 2 free grid points」其實是 flood fill 的 seed 數，自由格點是 694 與 1,055；距離與殘基數都正確。
changes.en: WM-162 moved to conflict: the 111 and 2 'free grid points' are the flood fill's seed counts, while the free points are 694 and 1,055; the distances and residue counts are correct.

changes.zh: 重算確認：長度＋淨電荷對 HADDOCK 分數的 R² = 0.929（PEPR1），每殘基 −7.44；截短階梯 34 個複合體、每 1,000 Å² −72 到 −86；串聯重複每殘基埋藏面積 127 → 32 Å²；9-23 質量 1,612.73 Da 與胰蛋白酶切位 3 → 1。
changes.en: Recomputed and confirmed: R2 = 0.929 for the HADDOCK score on length plus net charge (PEPR1) at -7.44 per residue; the 34-complex truncation ladder between -72 and -86 per 1,000 A2; the tandem sweep's buried area per residue from 127 to 32 A2; and 9-23's mass of 1,612.73 Da with trypsin sites going from three to one.

changes.zh: 仍 pending 但已註明搜尋結果：18 位點 alanine scan 的彙總表不在封存（只有執行樹），限制條件推導（WHISCY、US-align、DisVis、PEPR2 轉移）留在已不存在的運算工作區。
changes.en: Still pending but annotated with what the search found: the 18-position alanine scan has a run tree but no summary table in the archive, and the restraint-derivation work (WHISCY, US-align, DisVis, the PEPR2 transfer) stayed in the compute workspace that no longer exists.

changes.zh: 濕實驗原始檔核對（~/Downloads/Wetlab stuff：4 月至 10 月電子實驗記錄本、植物記錄本、各月膠片標註與圖表、protocol 與 SOP、四層選殖產物 SnapGene 檔、2026 primer list，共 122 個檔案全文檢索）：處理 901 筆未決事實中的 451 筆，190 筆更新，128 筆改為 confirmed，26 筆由 pending 改為 conflict，34 筆既有 conflict 補上原始數據實際內容。
changes.en: Wet lab raw-file check over ~/Downloads/Wetlab stuff (the electronic lab notebook April to October, the plant notebook, the per-gel label sheets and figure decks, the protocol and SOP folders, the four SnapGene cloning-product folders and the 2026 primer list; 122 files searched in full): 451 of the 901 unresolved facts worked through, 190 facts updated, 128 moved to confirmed, 26 moved from pending to conflict because the raw file contradicts the page, and 34 existing conflicts annotated with what the raw data shows.

changes.zh: confirmed 的判準：原始檔本身寫出同一個數值、單位、日期與構築，並附上逐字引文與檔案路徑。190 筆引文中 180 筆經程式驗證為語料的精確子字串，其餘 10 筆為表格換行所致，逐一人工核對。只存在於照片中的數值（條帶數、哪些 lane 有帶）不予 confirmed。
changes.en: Rule used for confirmed: the raw file states the fact itself, the same value, unit, date and construct, and the fact carries a verbatim quote and the file path. 180 of the 190 quotes verify as exact substrings of the corpus; the other 10 are table rows the converter reflowed and were checked token by token. A value that exists only in a photograph, such as a band count or which lanes banded, was not confirmed.

changes.zh: 開放問題 37（純化標籤位置）有三個各自為真的答案，依構築族群而定：ACCD 與 LEA 產物的 6xHis 在 3' 端，兩個 AmilCP 載貨完全沒有標籤，BoPep4 變異體以 _1-23_NHis 建構為 N 端標籤。WM-159 維持 conflict 並逐一寫明，因為 Peptide Design 與 Molecular Dynamics 兩句話仍須修改。
changes.en: Open question 37, the purification tag position, has three answers that are each true of a different construct family: 6xHis at the 3' end in every annotated ACCD and LEA product, no tag at all on the two AmilCP cargoes, and an N-terminal tag on the BoPep4 variants built as _1-23_NHis. WM-159 stays conflict with the per-construct resolution written out, because two wiki sentences still need editing.

changes.zh: WW-131（critical）改為 conflict：生物反應器時間序列實際上是兩天三張膠片（9/2 的 16/18/20 h 由 Chars，9/5 兩張為 20/22/24 h 與 40/42/44 h 由 Sophie C），共八個時間點，沒有 9/4，整個封存中也沒有 14 h 樣品。
changes.en: WW-131, a critical fact, moves to conflict: the reactor time course is three gels over two days, 2 September at 16/18/20 h by Chars and 5 September at 20/22/24 h and 40/42/44 h by Sophie C. Eight time points, nothing dated 4 September, and no 14 h sample exists anywhere in the archive.

changes.zh: WH-119、WH-122、WH-128 維持 confirmed 但加註：電子實驗記錄本在 9/19 沒有任何 LPA 執行紀錄，9 月膠片資料夾中疑似的光照實驗日期為 9/29。日期若改，群組標題與 Hardware、LPA 時間軸都要跟著動。
changes.en: WH-119, WH-122 and WH-128 keep their confirmed status with a note added: the electronic lab notebook has no LPA run on 19 September, and the candidate optogenetic run in the September gel folder is dated 29 September. If the date changes, the group title and the Hardware and LPA timeline entries move with it.

changes.zh: 濕實驗無法確認的大宗缺檔：定序報告（可一次關閉七筆）、Agar/ 資料夾的根長與葉綠素工作簿（28 筆）、Hydroponic system/ 與 Soil planting/（11 筆）、以及所有硬體檔案（LED、PWM、光學、壓力、流量皆零命中）。
changes.en: The large gaps the wet lab folder cannot close: the sequencing reports, which would settle seven facts at once; the Agar folder's root-length and chlorophyll workbooks, 28 facts; the hydroponic and soil folders, 11 facts; and every hardware file, since LED, PWM, optics, pressure and flow return zero hits in the whole corpus.

changes.zh: 完整紀錄、問題清單與 wiki 修正清單：records/2026-10-14-wetlab-pass.md；九份分區報告與套用的 patch 在 records/2026-10-14-wetlab/。
changes.en: Full write-up, the morning ask list and the wiki edit list: records/2026-10-14-wetlab-pass.md. The nine per-area reports and the applied patches are in records/2026-10-14-wetlab/.
